_comment: Descriptive JSON-shape schema for monster/enemy definitions (data/monsters/<id>.json). A human-readable shape guide for validators/tooling, NOT a strict JSON-Schema document. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority for all monster stats, AI, and combat (monsters are server-authoritative, in-memory, ids in band 30000-39999, not client-predicted) — 'the client requests, the server decides'; enemy files are a client mirror and the server wins on disagreement. Governing docs: docs/systems/monster-architecture.md (the data-driven three-layer model: base scene + JSON definition + schema), docs/gdd/MONSTERS.md, docs/server/contract.md (id ranges). INVARIANT: monster ids 30000-39999. Shape below is DERIVED from the existing data/monsters/toxic_slime.json definition. TODO: promote to formal JSON-Schema if the validators/ pipeline requires; fill optional fields (status effects, phases for bosses) as the monster system grows.

fields.id: string — stable monster id, matches filename
fields.tier: int 1-7 — biome tier (gates loot/level; see data/world/biomes.json)
fields.abilities: object[] — {id, type, damage, cooldown, projectile_speed, telegraph}

invariants: all monster state is server-authoritative and in-memory; never client-predicted
